quest.title: Supreme Hookshot?
quest.description: Kayvan the angler seems to be working tirelessly toward a certain goal...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of materials do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: I'm feeling... Zaytun Peach today.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: It's common, but few consider it an ingredient with which to make bait.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Please find that for me, would you?

talks.objective: Give the bait materials to Kayvan

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Great, we have all the materials. Now witness the creation of a unique bait.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kayvan skillfully prepares the bait.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Alright, here goes. Hooks away!

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Hook depth good... Flow speed moderate...

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: You gotta be quiet. The fish are really sensitive.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Even the footsteps on the bank could startle them.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Then be patient and wait...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Kayvan catches a wet package.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is this? That's no fish!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I sure have never seen a "fish" like that.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: So that happened again. Just as expected.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Don't worry, outlander, stay calm. Don't gripe too much about the details.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Everything that comes with a hook could be considered a "fish."

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Let me tell you, I didn't just invent the title of "the greatest angler" out of thin air.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: After all, always catching lifeless things that could never bite the bait is something quite special, wouldn't you say?

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Other anglers have praised my unique talents.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So basically, you catch everything but fish...

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Ahem! I don't care what they think! A—At least I never go home empty-handed!

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: I'll come again if I fail today, and I'll definitely catch a fish someday!

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Anyway, thanks for finding the materials. Please take your payment here. I'm fishing somewhere else.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Next time... Next time, I'll definitely get a big fish! I'm sure of it!

talks.objective: Look for the materials that Kayvan needs

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of materials do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: I'm feeling... How about a mushroom today?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: The mushrooms I usually use are found in a special area, I'll show you where they can be found.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Please find this sort of mushroom for me.

talks.objective: Give the bait materials to Kayvan

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: The bait this time requires Sunsettia, Wheat, and Zaytun Peach. Did you get them all?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: The bait this time requires Sunsettia, Wheat, and Special Bird Eggs. Did you get them all?

talks.objective: Give the bait materials to Kayvan

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: You look like... You're a Traveler, right? Hanging out in such a place, are we? Nice choice.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Could it be that you are another fisher with your eyes on this area?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: You've got a good eye! It's the best fishing site around these parts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But no one's fishing here, right? How can you be so certain?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Well, because I can see things they can't.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: I'm the best angler here, and I have my own standards for fishing sites.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: R—Really?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But where's the fish you caught?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Say no more. I'll show you what it means to be the "Supreme Hookshot."

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Bring me some special materials, and I will catch "fish" you've never seen before using my handmade bait.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That feels... kinda suspicious. Will this handmade bait really work?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wouldn't hurt to try.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: That's the spirit! I like you!

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: My handmade bait is based on Sunsettia and Wheat and is then further elevated by another material.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of materials do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: I'm feeling up to some... Bird Eggs fresh from the nest today.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: The eggs I usually use are found on the tree nearby. I'll show you the way.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: The bait this time requires Sunsettia, Wheat, and a Special Mushroom. Did you get them all?
